# … 嘛 · *… maa3*

**Meaning:** it's obvious; that's why (giving a reason) · **Level:** B1 · **Topic:** Sentence-final particles

> **Draft: awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [report it](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new?template=content-error.yml&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20grammar%2Fmaa3-obvious).

嘛 presents something as obvious, or as the reason behind what you are saying: "well, she is a teacher". It can also reassure: 唔緊要嘛 means "it really doesn't matter".

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **佢係老師嘛，梗係識啦。** |
| Jyutping | keoi5 hai6 lou5 si1 maa3, gang2 hai6 sik1 laa1. |
| Yale | kéuih haih lóuh sī ma, gáng haih sīk lā. |
| Bopomofo | ㄎㆤㄧ⁵ ㄏㄜㄧ⁶ ㄌㄛㄨ⁵ ㄙㄧ¹ ㄇㄚ³, ㄍㄜㄥ² ㄏㄜㄧ⁶ ㄙㄧㆶ¹ ㄌㄚ¹. |
| English | She's a teacher, so of course she knows. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **我都話咗會落雨嘛。** |
| Jyutping | ngo5 dou1 waa6 zo2 wui5 lok6 jyu5 maa3. |
| Yale | ngóh dōu wah jó wúih lohk yúh ma. |
| Bopomofo | ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄉㄛㄨ¹ ㄨㄚ⁶ ㄗㄛ² ㄨㄨㄧ⁵ ㄌㄛㆶ⁶ ㄩ⁵ ㄇㄚ³. |
| English | I did say it would rain. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **唔緊要嘛，下次再嚟啦。** |
| Jyutping | m4 gan2 jiu3 maa3, haa6 ci3 zoi3 lai4 laa1. |
| Yale | m̀h gán yiu ma, hah chi joi làih lā. |
| Bopomofo | ㆬ⁴ ㄍㄜㄣ² ㄧㄨ³ ㄇㄚ³, ㄏㄚ⁶ ㄘㄧ³ ㄗㄛㄧ³ ㄌㄜㄧ⁴ ㄌㄚ¹. |
| English | It doesn't matter; come again next time. |

## Common mistakes

- Not ~~佢係老師嗎，梗係識啦。~~ but **佢係老師嘛，梗係識啦。** *keoi5 hai6 lou5 si1 maa3, gang2 hai6 sik1 laa1.* · *kéuih haih lóuh sī ma, gáng haih sīk lā.*  
  Written with the character for the question particle, this looks like a question. Both are said maa3; here the meaning is "obviously", so the sentence states something and does not ask.
